Plot matched-bootstrap FPCA eigenvalue and variance-ratio uncertainty

etr_plot_fpca_spectrum_uncertainty.Rd

Displays original bootstrap-calibrated FPC spectrum uncertainty for a declared metric on the native fitted scale. Component-wise and familywise calibration refer to original native estimator output. The plot never invents new coverage guarantees or clips endpoints to mathematical support. Matplotlib runtime object identity and pixel matching remain outside this source-scientific contract.

Usage

etr_plot_fpca_spectrum_uncertainty(
    result, metric = "explained_variance_ratio",
    strict_source_record = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

result

Actual native FPCA spectrum uncertainty result with aligned component eigenvalues and bootstrap intervals for eigenvalue, explained-variance ratio and cumulative ratio.

metric

Exactly one of "eigenvalue", "explained_variance_ratio" or "cumulative_variance_ratio".

strict_source_record

Return a typed native R scientific record preserving Python source errorbar arrays, marker "o", capsize 3, variance-ratio source ylabel and familywise versus component-wise title; not Python Axes.

...

Native base graphics options.

Value

Default invisible retained-component source point and interval data frame, or strict source scientific errorbar artist metadata with component positions and asymmetric lower/upper uncertainty.
